name: cecil
tagline_zh: 不会配模板？写不出内容结构？Cecil 帮你从零搭好静态站，连生成命令都替你试好，你只管写 Markdown。
tagline_en: Stuck on config or templates? Cecil builds your static site from scratch, tests the build command, so you just.
desc_en: Build and configure Cecil static sites, with focused guidance for content, templates, and site generation.
why_zh: 不止给命令，还主动检查配置和模板，像贴身顾问一样，避免你踩坑。
why_en: It proactively validates config and templates, acting like a personal guide to avoid common pitfalls.
